response.sql: WITH rt AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), ov AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rt) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS total_payment, AVG(rt.total - ov.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rt CROSS JOIN ov WHERE rt.total > ov.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
